text: {"features":[{"name":"Software lifecycle ownership","description":"How convincingly the letter shows hands-on experience testing, maintaining, launching, and operating production software over meaningful time.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives only bare-minimum or vague software experience, with little sense of production ownership beyond having worked as an engineer."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States some production experience but with limited scope, few specifics, or emphasis on only one part of the lifecycle."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly shows solid end-to-end experience across testing, maintenance, and launching a modest number of production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows several years of broad production ownership with evidence of maintaining and launching multiple services or growing into greater responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents extensive, credible lifecycle ownership as a core identity, showing long-running responsibility for multiple production systems and clear maturation from maintenance into stewardship."}]},{"name":"Go engineering depth","description":"The extent to which the letter shows Go as a strong, central language for backend systems relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only as one language used, with no indication that it is central to the candidate's work or systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Identifies Go as a regular language but gives little evidence of backend ownership or concrete Go-built services."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes Go a clear part of recent production work and ties it to service development."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows Go as a primary language and links it to designing or operating backend infrastructure relevant to security or automation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Portrays Go as the backbone of the candidate's backend work, with concrete examples of building the services, guardrails, or infrastructure most analogous to this role."}]},{"name":"Python engineering depth","description":"The extent to which the letter demonstrates substantive production use of Python for systems, tooling, or automation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python at all or mentions it only implicitly."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Refers to Python in passing without showing meaningful production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for tooling, scripts, or internal services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial production-grade Python work, such as typed or tested services, automation layers, or critical internal tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes Python a clearly trusted second working language, central to both automation and service building and directly relevant to AI agents or security workflows."}]},{"name":"AI production experience","description":"How well the letter demonstrates practical experience shipping AI functionality in production and handling its operational realities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of working with AI systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or exposure but no shipped production use or operational learning."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience shipping AI or LLM-backed features but with limited detail on reliability, evaluation, or failure handling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes meaningful production AI work and shows awareness of trustworthiness, evaluation, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents AI as a substantial, role-relevant part of recent work, with concrete evidence of deploying model-backed functionality responsibly in production."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"How strongly the letter shows experience architecting agent-based systems with explicit control, boundaries, and supporting infrastructure.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of designing agent-based systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"References automation or AI workflows but does not show autonomous agents, system boundaries, or architecture."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Indicates end-to-end agentic tooling experience, usually by pairing Python agents with backend services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes clear architectural ownership of agent systems, including constraints, permissions, auditability, or guardrails."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows sophisticated agentic design thinking directly aligned to the role, with Python agents granted bounded autonomy and Go infrastructure explicitly enforcing control."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"The degree to which the letter demonstrates hands-on ability to perform meaningful security assessments of software and systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Implies general security awareness but no clear hands-on assessment work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience with security assessments, threat models, or reviews at a general level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete assessment practices such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface analysis, or remediation validation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows mature, builder-oriented security assessment work that spans design and legacy systems and treats remediation as part of engineering ownership."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability-handling automation","description":"How convincingly the letter shows direct experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of automating vulnerability handling or triage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security workflow improvement in broad terms but not concrete vulnerability automation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States that the candidate automated vulnerability intake or triage with some operational benefit."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes specific triage capabilities such as classification, routing, deduplication, or queue reduction."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents vulnerability handling automation as a major, proven accomplishment that materially turned a manual, expert-heavy workflow into scalable tooling."}]},{"name":"Data structures and algorithms fluency","description":"How well the letter demonstrates applied strength with data structures and algorithms through concrete engineering examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of algorithmic thinking beyond generic software claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic strength in generic terms without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one clear example of using data structures or algorithms to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong applied algorithmic judgment through a specific redesign of a hot path, scheduler, dedup pipeline, lookup service, or similar core system."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes algorithmic fluency feel like a reliable strength, with concrete examples showing material simplification or performance gains in nontrivial systems."}]},{"name":"Platform engineering orientation","description":"The extent to which the letter shows fit for foundational, shared infrastructure work with broad organizational leverage.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frames the role mainly as a general software job and shows little interest in foundational or shared infrastructure."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some attraction to scale but little explicit preference for central platform work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Expresses clear interest in building shared systems or infrastructure used by other teams."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Strongly aligns past work and future goals with foundational tooling whose benefits are inherited broadly across an organization."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes platform leverage a central professional theme, convincingly showing that the candidate seeks and understands high-leverage infrastructure roles like this one."}]},{"name":"Developer-enablement orientation","description":"How clearly the letter frames impact in terms of helping other engineers work effectively and securely.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Says little about serving other engineers or shaping secure defaults."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions helping teams in passing but without concrete empathy for internal users."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a clear desire to reduce friction for other engineers or make secure behavior easier."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes building tools close to users, respecting downstream teams, or making the secure path the easy path."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently frames impact through the success of other engineers, showing strong internal-customer empathy and a service mindset well matched to developer-facing security tooling."}]},{"name":"Security-scaling mindset","description":"How well the letter understands the role as building systems that scale scarce security expertise and reduce manual security toil.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Treats security mainly as a general interest area rather than as a systems-scaling problem."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions automation or security separately but does not connect them into a coherent view of scaled security work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a basic understanding that automation can reduce manual security work and expand team capacity."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly frames the job as using systems to scale scarce security expertise across many products or teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates a sharp, role-specific view of security automation as capacity multiplication, variant analysis, or secure-default infrastructure rather than ad hoc firefighting."}]},{"name":"Offensive-security credibility","description":"The strength of attacker-oriented security evidence presented through competitions, certifications, or other hands-on practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of attacker-oriented practice or validated security skill."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows only light or indirect security validation, such as a basic certification or casual participation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a credible signal such as recurring capture-the-flag participation or a relevant certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong offensive credibility through OSCP-level validation, serious capture-the-flag practice, or both."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys unusually strong attacker-oriented grounding, such as OSCP plus strong competition results or other evidence of sustained, high-level offensive practice."}]},{"name":"Independent technical initiative","description":"How much the letter adds credible engineering evidence beyond job duties through open-source work, side projects, or upstream contributions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no technical evidence beyond stated job responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small personal project or occasional upstream patching, but the extra work is modest or lightly described."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a meaningful extracurricular engineering habit through a maintained side project, open-source contribution, or nontrivial build."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents substantial evidence outside the day job, such as maintaining an actively used open-source project or building a challenging distributed system."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Provides especially strong external evidence of engineering depth and initiative, combining public maintenance, upstream responsibility, or ambitious self-directed systems work."}]},{"name":"Achievement specificity","description":"How concretely the letter substantiates its claims with observable examples, outcomes, and scope.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on generic assertions with little concrete detail, outcome, or example."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few specifics but still reads largely as unsupported claim or requirement matching."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Uses several concrete examples to substantiate skills, though outcomes or scope are only moderately clear."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Regularly grounds claims in observable details such as named responsibilities, before-and-after effects, system types, or scope of work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes the case through precise, credible evidence throughout, using concrete examples and outcomes so that major claims feel well substantiated rather than merely asserted."}]},{"name":"Role-specific motivation","description":"How persuasively the letter explains why this particular role is the candidate's intended next step.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives generic interest in the job with little sense of why this role is the right next step."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses sincere enthusiasm but could plausibly be sent to many backend or security roles with minimal change."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects some past experience to the team's mission and gives a reasonably role-specific reason for applying."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Persuasively explains why the combination of security, automation, AI agents, and Google-scale infrastructure fits the candidate's trajectory."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes the role feel like a natural continuation of the candidate's work and values, with a distinctive and convincing statement of why this specific team is the target."}]},{"name":"Narrative coherence","description":"How well the letter is organized into a clear, persuasive arc from background to fit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as a loose list of facts or slogans with weak progression from background to fit."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has some structure but jumps between points or leaves the overall case underdeveloped."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Follows a clear enough arc from experience to role fit, even if parts feel formulaic."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Organizes the letter into a coherent, easy-to-follow argument in which examples build toward the application case."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers a particularly clean and memorable arc, with a strong opening frame and a through-line that ties qualifications, motivation, and fit together."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"The degree of mechanical correctness and professional fluency in the prose.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent spelling, grammar, or usage errors that noticeably undermine professionalism or readability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains multiple visible errors or awkward constructions that distract from the message."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has a few minor errors but remains generally clear and professional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is mechanically strong, with only rare slips that do not affect credibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is essentially error-free and polished, with fluent phrasing and no distracting mechanical issues."}]}]}
